title: Stay on your feet
text: What do you do as they come at you?
tip: Before you tackle, check if anyone can help. With no help yet, stay on your feet and slow them down.

options.text: Stay on your feet and wait
options.why: The look showed the ball under control and help on its way. Stay on your feet until it arrives.
You stay in the way, but every step back lets them get nearer your goal.

options.text: Go in for the tackle now
options.why: Dive in now and they go round you with nobody else to stop them.

scan.prompt: An attacker is dribbling straight at you. Have a quick look first.
